title: The commit-msg hook refuses a planning commit whose KB-Work names an item it does not change, as check-trailers does at the push
goal: kbgit.py commit-msg exits non-zero, and the commit is not made, for a backlog-planning commit whose KB-Work names an item whose file it does not change, since check-trailers refuses that commit at the push anyway (SP-7nv2ffr2: the hook printed the refusal and the commit was made, then amended by hand) (SP-7nv2ffr2 close).
notes: SP-djl7za6x close: the orchestrator's commit of two confirmed provisional answers named the review item in KB-Work; commit-msg printed the refusal but the commit was made, and sync's check-trailers refused it (twice, the second time for space-separated ids where a comma list is required). Recurred in SP-htl7jkrm (2026-10-13): the review's confirm commit named the review item in KB-Work without changing its file, then two ids separated by a space; the commit-msg hook only warned and check-trailers refused the push twice before 'ST-a, ST-b' passed.
